patterns.note: Complete product API exemplar: one small class with private in-memory state, typed snake_case methods, and direct return values.
Complete test exemplar: standard-library unittest drives the public NoteStore lifecycle and checks return values plus observable list state.

risks.risk: delete is explicitly typed as bool, but only one in-repository truthiness consumer is visible; external consumers relying on exact boolean identity or type cannot be traced from this checkout
the sole test covers only a successful deletion of the only note, with no missing-id, remaining-note, repeated-delete, or exact-return-value coverage
the UI motivating the outcome is not present in this one-module product, so its integration contract cannot be inspected here

conventions: README.md: A minimal note store used to exercise the Lantern factory. One module, one test file.
tests/test_notes.py uses standard-library unittest and adds src to sys.path
src/notes.py uses snake_case methods, underscore-prefixed private state, four-space indentation, and built-in generic type annotations
No lint, formatter, build, dependency, migration, or feature-flag convention is declared in the tracked checkout
